verdict.rationale: macOS documents task automation through Shortcuts (macos-docs-19), and Safari Notify Me watches pages for changes and alerts you (macos-docs-34). Neither item shows a user scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. The evidence supports automation in general but not time-based recurrence. Missing for 10: documented recurring or time-based scheduling of workflows (e.g., scheduled Shortcuts automations, launchd/cron), schedule configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
